CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS api_key_v2 ( username VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, principals ${BINARY_TYPE} NOT NULL,
domain VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, access_key VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, secret VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
created TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, created_by_user_id VARCHAR(200), created_by_realm VARCHAR(200),
CONSTRAINT pk_api_key_v2_username_domain_principals PRIMARY KEY (username, domain, principals), CONSTRAINT uk_api_key_v2_domain_access_key UNIQUE (domain, access_key) );
